notes: MoonRewards accepts permanent MOON deposits and pays verified mission claims subject to immutable daily caps and the post office requirement. MoonShop implements the Courier Companions ERC-1155 collection and recycles shop payments into MoonRewards after sending half, rounded down, to the burn address. Both application owners and the shop's 5% royalty recipient resolve to $owner. The owner configures the game-server voucher signer and shop catalog after launch; claims require initial funding. No factory initialization calls are required. The factory supplies the LP, MerkleDistributor and initialization-only pool guard. Services handle publication, attestation, admission and deployment.
